description:
Aggregate the layering fixes and the one-form convergences: domain purity and typed domain errors, and each duplicated primitive or rule listed by the epic reduced to one form.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The domain layer imports nothing from `repository_state`, returns typed errors, and reports layout violations through a domain type matched exhaustively.
- [hard] REQ-02: Process liveness, safe relative paths, issue scopes and type extraction each have one form.
- [hard] REQ-03: Adopter documentation states the issue scope grammar as the code now behaves.
title: Layering and duplicated primitives converge on one form
